content: समयः .²1 Time in general. .²2 Occassion, opportunity; न तैः समयमन्विच्छेत् पुरुषो धर्ममाचरन् <ls>Ms. 10. 53</ls>. .²3 Fit time, proper time or season, right moment; गन्तुं प्रवृत्ते समयं विलङ्घ्य <ls>Ku. 3. 35</ls>. .²4 An agreement, a compact, contract, an engagement; मिथःसमयात् <ls>Ś. 5</ls>. .²5 A convention, conventional usage. .²6 An established rule of conduct, a ceremonial custom, usual practice, observance; निह्नवन्ति च ये तेषां समयं सुकृतं च यत् <ls>Mb. 12. 229. 8</ls>; निरस्तनारीसमया दुराधयः <ls>Ki. 1. 28</ls>; <ls>U. 1</ls>. .²7 The convention of poets; ({%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} that persons separated from their beloveds are affected at the sight of clouds.). .²8 An appointment, assignation. .²9 A condition, stipulation; <ls>V. 5</ls>. .²10 A law, rule, regulation; वीराणां समयो हि दारुणरसः स्नेहक्रमं बाधते <ls>U. 5. 19</ls>. .²11 Direction, order, instruction, precept. .²12 Emergency, exigency. .²13 An oath; कामं तथा तिष्ठ नरेन्द्र तस्मिन् यथा कृतस्ते समयः सभायाम् <ls>Mb. 3. 183. 35</ls>. .²14 A sign, hint, indication; शौरिसमयनिगृहीतधियः <ls>Śi. 15. 41</ls>. .²15 Limit, boundary. .²16 A demonstrated conclusion, doctrine, tenet; बौद्ध˚, वैशेषिक˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²17 End, conclusion, termination. .²18 Success, prosperity. .²19 End of trouble. (समयेन ‘on condition, conditionally’.)
